item.title: White people were 6% of arrests by Memphis Safe Task Force in its first two months
item.description: More than 3,000 people were arrested during the first two months of the Memphis Safe Task Force’s deployment. Only 6% of them appeared to be white, according to an MLK50: Justice Through Journalism analysis. The findings support assertions by some Memphians that the task force mostly affects Black and brown residents. item.title: How LeMoyne-Owen College grew Memphis’ Black theater scene
item.description: It’s small, but the Black theater scene in Memphis has been notable for 50 years. Levi and Debroah Frazier founded the Blues City Cultural Center, a nonprofit that stages local plays, arts shows and workshops for aspiring creative writers, in 1979.
